professional_summary: Passionate, empathetic and motivated Community Services worker with experience in case management, client liaison, and employment support for refugee, asylum seeker, and CALD clients. Skilled in conducting comprehensive intake assessments, identifying employment barriers, developing individual career and job plans, and advocating on behalf of clients. Experienced in implementing job-focused solutions through program-based initiatives, with strong communication, problem-solving, organisational skills and CRM proficiency.

responsibilities: Work directly with refugee, asylum seeker and CALD women to enhance employability, confidence, and independence
Develop and implement individual case plans by assessing each client's goals, barriers, strengths, and support needs
Apply a client-centred, trauma-informed, and strengths-based approach to build trust and empower women from diverse cultural backgrounds
Support clients in developing practical, entrepreneurial, and employability skills through workshops, one-on-one sessions, and referrals to relevant services
Maintain accurate, confidential records of client progress and outcomes using CRM platforms and Excel, ensuring compliance with organisational and privacy standards
Conduct referrals and follow up on outcomes to provide holistic support
Collaborate with internal teams and volunteers to coordinate services and ensure seamless delivery of programs
Perform VEVO checks to verify work rights and eligibility for program participation
Promote inclusion by adapting communication and program delivery to accommodate different literacy levels, cultural expectations, and learning styles
Provided professional and welcoming support, offering information, directions, and assistance to visitors
Communicated clearly and empathetically with a diverse range of local and international guests, including those from different linguistic and cultural backgrounds, ensuring positive experiences
De-escalated customer concerns with professionalism, patience, and active listening
Stayed informed on store relocations, renovations, and new openings to provide accurate and updated information
Collaborated with internal teams, including concierge, security, and valet, to ensure smooth issue resolution and service delivery
Supported children's social, emotional, and behavioural development through inclusive, strengths-based approaches
Maintained compliance with child protection and duty of care requirements
Maintained accurate attendance, incident, and behavioural records
Adapted care and communication strategies to support children with ADHD, autism, and other neurodiverse needs, ensuring an inclusive and supportive environment

work_history.position: Customer Service and Risk Assessment Specialist
responsibilities: Conducted detailed client assessments and delivered tailored advice, demonstrating problem-solving and analytical skills
Communicated complex information clearly to clients from diverse backgrounds, maintaining patience and empathy
Maintained accurate records and exceeded KPIs through proactive, client-focused service and met organisational standards for compliance and data integrity
Supported members of the community during COVID-19 by providing clear, helpful information about health guidelines, vaccinations, and travel rules
Assisted people from diverse cultural and linguistic backgrounds, demonstrating patience, empathy, and understanding
Made outbound calls for contact tracing and vaccination bookings, ensuring people received the right support and information
Helped new staff learn procedures and provided guidance to ensure consistent, community-focused service
Maintained accurate records and protected clients' privacy while delivering support to the public

core_competencies: Case management and intake client assessment
Advocacy and negotiation with external agencies
technical_skills: Excel for client records and data management
soft_skills: Mental health and social inclusion support

volunteer.description: Supported community-based programs for refugees, second-generation migrants, and CALD youth, promoting mental health, wellbeing, and social inclusion. Assisted with community engagement through social media, photography, and outreach to increase youth participation. Collaborated with the event coordinator to plan and run fundraising initiatives, including sausage sizzles. Contributed to the Intergenerational Trauma Program by helping plan and run workshops for refugee and CALD families.
